verdict.rationale: Claude provides incognito chats that are excluded from model training even with Model Improvement enabled, and explicitly states connector data (Gmail/Drive/Calendar) is never used for training; users can also manage privacy settings controlling model improvement. However, evidence doesn't show a simple universal opt-out toggle for all conversation data across all plans, nor independent verification of these claims. missing for 10: documentation of a general account-wide training opt-out setting for all chat data (not just incognito/connectors), independent/third-party verification of these training-exclusion claims.
